description: Lists of objects whose tuple attributes swap number and string unify keeping a string a string
notes: The input needs a null set whose element type is the dynamic pseudo-type (s), which the spec has no value for: the dynamic pseudo-type is a placeholder for a type that isn't known yet, so no value should have it as a collection's element type. Apart from that, the spec gives the same result. The spec unifies the attributes one by one: a to tuple([string, string]), b to number and c to the dynamic pseudo-type, so the string "x" stays a string. The result's full type differs (go-cty gives p's type, with a number in a), so the test reads only "x". The set makes go-cty rank the given types instead of building a new one. It ranks neither list above the other (a ranks each way once, and two numbers or two dynamic pseudo-types rank equal in compareTypes in cty/convert/compare_types.go), so it tries them in the order given and picks p's type.
